items.title: Your note decides the code
items.body_html: Write the supported diagnosis, not the symptom, and the duration and severity behind it. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Dental claims
items.body_html: Record the tooth, the finding and the procedure so the code and the service match. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Query, don't guess
items.body_html: If the note only supports a symptom code, query the clinician before submitting. Proposed — SME to confirm.

screen.title: Check: covered?
screen.prompt_html: Quick check (not scored). If my treatment is clinically correct, the claim will be covered.

feedback.correct_html: Right — it's false. Coverage depends on the table of benefits and on the documentation.
feedback.incorrect_html: Not always: if it isn't documented properly, it won't be covered — even when it's clinically correct.

append_html.rcma-091: As a {{role_label}}: pick one recent note and check it against the six-point checklist.
